question: Six ladies Anu, Preeti, Arti, Kirti, Poonam and Suman are seated at a circular table facing the centre. Preeti is sitting opposite to Poonam. Poonam is sitting exactly between Kirti and Anu. Arti sits to the immediate right of Anu. Who sits to the immediate right of Preeti?
solution: Six ladies **Anu, Preeti, Arti, Kirti, Poonam and Suman** are seated at a circular table facing the centre. 1. Preeti is sitting opposite to Poonam.
